name: scripted_walk_from_standing_snapshot
description: Exact reproduction of the E0 driven-dynamics walk.  Loads the pre-trained standing brain snapshot (frozen — holds posture without fighting the gait), then injects the open-loop scripted gait on top.  REQUIRES the N1_accelfix config + g6dof joint backend (the substrate the snapshot was trained on).  Walk pattern, hip1_phase=pi (best propulsion), amp hip1/hip2=0.4 knee=0.3, period 60.  Single stage — the body stands instantly from the snapshot and the gait runs immediately.  Tweak SG amps/phase/period live to explore the envelope.
